# v0.25.0

## Changes (English)

- Carry over the Desktop app's SSH connections (#239). Environments created with "Separate conversations and memory too" and "Separate the account only" now copy the Code tab's SSH connection list and the remote folder per host (ssh_configs.json and ssh_worktree_locations.json) once at creation. Remembered SSH passwords and per-host tokens are never carried over, so the first connection asks for the password or key again. You can change this per environment under "Configure in detail, item by item".
- Stop sharing the Code tab's conversation list, and repair environments that v0.24.8 linked (#238). The Desktop app does not save through links in its data folder, so the shared list introduced in v0.24.8 showed the conversations but could not save new ones. Each environment now keeps its own list in every mode. The next launch from CSW, or csw doctor --fix, removes the link v0.24.8 created and restores the environment's own list; conversations started while the link was in place remain in projects/ and can be opened with claude --resume.
